parsed.text: This packet contains fallible 4x4 location distributions for red and blue roles in two panels (p0, p1). Current estimates (not new when marked copied) are uniform across rows and columns for every addressed node except node n2 in both panels: current n2 concentrates blue on the top-right 2x2 cells ([0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]) and red on the top-left 2x2 cells ([0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]). Conditional candidate records vary by command: k0 duplicates the same n2 partition as the current estimate; k1 tightens peaks at single cells (blue at [0,2], red at [0,1]); k2 for n2 is uniform in these candidates. Origins and times are retained in the packet (some entries inherit copied prior records or conditional estimates); copied prior records are not new estimates, and conditional command records are conditional forecasts, not executed events.
